name: Telecommunications
summary: This module is designed to help students to:1.Build and define their employability skills. 2.Gain insights into a strength-based approach to both personal and organizational change and development - Appreciative Inquiry.
aims: These tasks aim to provide students with the opportunity to acquire a level of pErsonal and communication skills.
outcomes: By the end of the module the student will learn how to:1. Communicate their unique strengths.2. Use a collaborative and positive approach to generating solutions and managing personal and organizational change.

name: Multimedia Fundamental
summary: This module is an introduction to the analysis and processing of digital multimedia.The main methods of delivery are a mix of asynchronous activities and synchronous sessions (live lectures and tutorials).
aims: Students will be able to:1.discuss and compare multimedia data representations;2.relate data properties representation and size.
outcomes: Disciplinary Skills - able to:Identify appropriate image and audio processing algorithms. in order to solve typical problems in multimedia production.

name: Advanced Transform
summary: Time/frequency transforms are based on the Fourier Transform (FT). It then introduces time-frequency analysis techniques and explores how they are suitable for different signal and image processing applications such as filtering and compression.
aims: The broad aims of this module are to introduce a variety of transforms and provide an understanding of their mathematical framework and introduce how to apply the knowledge of these transforms and sub-band methods to compression and other applications.
outcomes: By the end of the module the student will be able to:1.Recall a range of joint time-frequency transforms.2.Compare the relative merits of different transforms.3.Recognise the common mathematical framework underlying many transform methods.

name: Image and Video Processing
summary: This course provides fundamental knowledge about well-established techniques for digital image and video processing.
aims: 1.To provide an understanding of the theoretical base for image and video processing. 2.To enable students to understand how image and video manipulation and enhancement techniques works. 3.To impart understanding of image and video coding techniques. 4.To give students experience of writing and testing software that manipulates and enhances images.
outcomes: Academic Content: A1. Understand the development of image and video coding as a series of historical developments.A2. Understand the series of processes used in video coding as a systems approach.A3. Analysis of the image and video coding techniques.Disciplinary Skills:B1. Use Matlab and covolution kernels to process images.B2. Apply image processing principles to solve image improvement and image and video compression problems.B3. Use a mixture of Matlab components and user software to solve a problems set.

name: Software Engineering
summary: An introduction to modern software development techniques necessary to produce high-quality software and to manage the production of this software.
aims: The course aims to give each participant: an idea of the necessity of good software engineering practice when developing complex software systems.
outcomes: By the end of the module the student will be able to:Devise a requirements specification. Build a system using modern software development techniques. Test the system using automated testing methods.

name: Interactive Media Design and Production
summary: The module provides principles and techniques of interactive media design and production using conventional media processing tools.
aims: 1.Study human aspects and interaction in the creation of artistic and informative media structures.2.Understand and practice usability evaluation methods.
outcomes: Academic Content:A1.Recognize the importance of human aspects in multimedia application design.A2.Understand the usage of common tools in multimedia design and production.A3.Be able to create multimedia applications considering the important aspects in a design process.
